title: Synthetic Two-Group Outcome Study
research_question: Is the intervention associated with a different follow-up outcome score, and does the association remain after adjustment for baseline score and age?
multiplicity_policy: Primary analysis is the group comparison. Secondary association and adjusted model are interpreted as supportive/exploratory.

analyses.question: Do follow-up outcome scores differ between intervention and control groups?
Is responder status associated with study group?
What is the adjusted association between study group and follow-up score?
